test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The committee’s decision, despite objections, (1)/ were accepted (2)/ by the authorities (3)/ unanimously. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence, "**The committee’s decision**," is singular.
 
• The verb "**were**" is plural and does not agree with the singular subject.
 
• The correct verb should be the singular form "**was**" to ensure subject-verb agreement.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The committee’s decision, despite objections, **was** accepted by the authorities unanimously."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1:** "The committee’s decision, despite objections," – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3:** "by the authorities" – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4:** "unanimously." – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
